zh-CN: 灵猴身法
en-US: Monkey Agility

zh-CN: 不着重甲时保持灵猴般的迅捷，提升移动与跳跃能力。
en-US: Move and leap with simian agility while fighting light.

zh-CN: 如意兵法
en-US: Ruyi Mastery

zh-CN: 精通棍棒与如意金箍棒的战斗技巧。
en-US: Master the staff and the Ruyi Jingu Bang.

zh-CN: 铜头铁臂
en-US: Copper Head, Iron Arms

zh-CN: 以仙躯硬撼刀兵，强化近战防御。
en-US: Harden your immortal body against physical blows.

zh-CN: 筋斗云
en-US: Somersault Cloud

zh-CN: 驾云跃至选定落点，迅速重定位战场位置。
en-US: Ride the cloud to a chosen point and rapidly reposition on the battlefield.

zh-CN: 火眼金睛
en-US: Fiery Golden Eyes

zh-CN: 看破妖邪与幻象，使目标显形并削弱其防御。
en-US: Pierce disguises and illusions, revealing and weakening the target.

zh-CN: 定海一棒
en-US: Sea-Calming Strike

zh-CN: 以金箍棒震击地面，对附近敌人造成雷鸣伤害，弱者更会被击倒并震退。
en-US: Smash the ground with the staff, dealing Thunder damage and knocking failed saves prone and away.

zh-CN: 云势
en-US: Cloud Momentum

zh-CN: 筋斗云带来的冲势强化下一次近战攻击。
en-US: Momentum from the Somersault Cloud empowers the next melee attack.

zh-CN: 妖邪显形
en-US: Demon Revealed

zh-CN: 目标的伪装被火眼金睛看破，护甲等级降低。
en-US: The target's disguise is pierced by Fiery Golden Eyes, reducing Armour Class.

zh-CN: 如意伸长
en-US: Ruyi Extension

zh-CN: 令金箍棒骤然伸长，打击远处的敌人。
en-US: Extend the Ruyi Jingu Bang to strike a distant foe.

zh-CN: 七十二变：小虫
en-US: Seventy-Two Transformations: Tiny Creature

zh-CN: 化作微小生灵，用于潜入狭窄区域与探索。首个技术原型暂借用猫形态验证变身链路。
en-US: Assume a tiny exploratory form for infiltration and traversal. The first technical prototype uses the Cat Wild Shape chain.

zh-CN: 七十二变：苍鹰
en-US: Seventy-Two Transformations: Eagle

zh-CN: 借飞禽之形腾空而起，跨越高低差与复杂地形。首个技术原型使用恐鸦形态验证飞行链路。
en-US: Take wing to cross vertical terrain and obstacles. The first technical prototype uses the Dire Raven Wild Shape chain.

zh-CN: 七十二变：猛虎
en-US: Seventy-Two Transformations: Tiger

zh-CN: 化作猛虎扑杀近敌，获得野兽形态的近战能力与耐久。首个技术原型使用剑齿虎形态。
en-US: Transform into a tiger-like combat form with beast melee attacks and durability. The first technical prototype uses the Sabre-Toothed Tiger Wild Shape chain.
